dying.label: The lantern is lit but three turns from dying
dying.explanation: A Warrior at depth 30 wears a lantern with three turns of fuel left and carries a fresh torch in the pack. The entry test's first clause already covers "no light", so its about-to-burn-out clause (timeout <= 3) never fired on its own: the original does nothing and lets the light go out. The corrected test starts the out-of-light maneuvers and swaps to the fresh torch.

everburn.label: Control: a fuel-less (everburning) light
everburn.explanation: A fuel-less light keeps its timeout permanently at zero; the correction's timeout arm only applies to fueled lights, so both versions leave it alone. The complete logs are byte-identical.
